gloss: whole body; with all one's might

definitions.gloss: whole body, with all one's might, putting everything into
definitions.explanation: Using one's entire body and spirit, pouring all of one's energy and effort into something. Almost always used as a modifier in the pattern {渾身|こんしん}の + noun, describing something done with maximum effort or intensity.

examples.japanese: {渾身|こんしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{投|な}げた→投げる：01135_nageru⟧。
examples.english: I threw with all my might.

examples.japanese: {渾身|こんしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一撃|いちげき}→一撃：08948_ichigeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{放|はな}った→放つ：10062_hanatsu⟧。
examples.english: He delivered a blow with everything he had.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{作者|さくしゃ}→作者：04169_sakusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{渾身|こんしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: This work is a novel that the author wrote pouring everything into it.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost exclusively used in the pattern {渾身|こんしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun. Rarely appears on its own. Conveys an intense, dramatic quality — the idea that someone has held nothing back.

Common in sports commentary, literary descriptions, and dramatic narratives.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {渾身|こんしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧: all one's strength
- {渾身|こんしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一撃|いちげき}→一撃：08948_ichigeki⟧: a blow with everything behind it
- {渾身|こんしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧: putting all one's strength into
- {渾身|こんしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧: a work created with full effort
- {渾身|こんしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演技|えんぎ}→演技：01890_engi⟧: a performance given with everything
